top_signals.title: Standard Chartered: Trump's Russian Diesel Won't Add New Supply
top_signals.summary: Oil prices were mixed in Thursday's trading session, with prospects of the United States easing restrictions on Russia's crude helping ease the international benchmark while attacks on vessels in the Middle East provided support. Brent crude for December delivery was down 0.2% to trade at $106 per barrel at 2.49 pm ET, while WTI crude for November delivery jumped 3.6% to trade at $98 per barrel.
